source: ClassPad.net Math — exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-19 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project.
notes: 51 native observations accepted in full LCD/status key replays. Three older out-of-field Range holdouts from beta38 also recovered without pixel changes or masks.

Range UP/DOWN wrap throughStart/End/Step/Execute. PageUp/PageDown jump to first/last and clamp there. The three-row viewport stays at offset1 when moving back fromExecute toStep/End, returning0 forStart.

RIGHT or EXE/OK on a selected value opens an empty field editor, whileLEFT is ignored. UP/DOWN and EXE on the empty editor are ignored; digits replace the prior value. AC repeatedly retains the empty editor. Back from an editor restores the selected field; anotherBack leaves Range forTable.

TOOLS is ignored while Range is open. In the initial reset-range sequence,tools then1 then1 typed11 intoStart, not1 via a menu; native laterStart11 is preserved and labels do not claim1. Reopening Range from theTable itself is valid.

All active range edits hide the scrollbar inLineI andMathI, including EXE-empty, direct-digit and AC-empty entry. Both paths were measured independently. This extends the earlier LineI-only implementation; prior MathI behavior was not sufficient evidence.
MathI change clearsf/g according to the established I/O rule; the later empty table/footer reflects undefined functions. This group changes Range navigation/edit lifecycle, not Table numeric limits.
